notes.title: Playtest signups open!
notes.notes:
[h2]🎮 Get Early Access to Chelesste! 🎮[/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that we're launching an exclusive playtest version, and we want [b]YOU [/b]to be a part of it!

Join us for an exclusive opportunity to get early access to [i][b]Chelesste[/b][/i], where chess meets card games in an exciting and fun way. You'll also have the chance to influence the development process and help shape the game's future!

[h2]Here's what you can look forward to:[/h2]

[olist]
[*]  Get a sneak peek at gameplay mechanics, features and cards.
[*]  Provide valuable feedback and suggestions that directly impact development choices.
[*]  Collaborate with our "team" [i](one developer)[/i] to refine the game and make it the best it can be.
[/olist]
[h2]Sign up right from the store page, we can't wait to see you in game![/h2]
[i]Also, as a treat, here is one of our [b]KING[/b] cards. (subject to change of course)[/i]
[i]- Str4nger[/i]
